info.name: GAISe API
info.description:
GAISe (Generative AI Service) exposes one provider-neutral contract over OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, and Ollama.

Routes: POST /v1/instruct, POST /v1/instruct/stream (SSE), POST /v1/embeddings, GET /v1/models, GET /v1/models/{provider}::{id}, GET /v1/live (WebSocket; not representable here).

Set the collection variables (base_url and one model per vendor) and configure the server with the provider credentials described in wiki/api.md#configuration. Full reference: wiki/README.md.

item.name: Models
item.description: Model discovery across every configured provider. Semantics: wiki/capabilities.md#model-discovery; catalog: wiki/models.md.

request.description: Fans out to every configured provider; per-provider failures are reported in `errors`, never dropped.
operation is one of instruct, instruct_stream, embeddings, live.
Models GAISe can drive through GET /v1/live (OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live).
Provider + operation filter.
One extra call per installed tag; returns capabilities and context length.
Attaches the provider's native model object as `raw`.
Single enriched record; 404 if the provider does not list it, 400 without the :: separator.
Cross-region profiles inherit the foundation model's capabilities.
Demonstrates query validation.

item.name: Instruct
item.description: Provider-neutral request shapes. Swap the model variable to route anywhere. Wire reference: wiki/api.md#post-v1instruct.

request.description: Adapters flatten nested parts while preserving order.
Audio input is native on Gemini/Vertex, OpenAI audio models, and Bedrock where permitted; Anthropic and Ollama return an explicit unsupported marker.
Returned bytes arrive as ordinary image content objects.
cache_key maps to prompt_cache_key on OpenAI; Anthropic uses automatic ephemeral cache control instead.
Response is text/event-stream.

item.name: Vendors
item.description: The same request set for each provider. Requires the matching credentials on the server.

item.name: OpenAI
item.description: Every route exercised against OpenAI. Model IDs come from collection variables. Mapping details: wiki/vendor-openai.md

request.description: Plain text instruct via OpenAI. See wiki/vendor-openai.md.
Multi-turn conversation with a system instruction. Fixed-sampling families drop temperature automatically.
Byte arrays are placeholders. Image support depends on the model; see wiki/capabilities.md#modalities-by-provider.
UTF-8 text files become tagged text on providers without native documents; PDFs are native on Anthropic, Gemini, Vertex, and Bedrock.
Reasoning controls map per provider (reasoning_effort, adaptive thinking, thinkingLevel/thinkingBudget, think). Accepted values per model are in wiki/models.md.
Expect an assistant message with tool_calls. Copy id/name into the next request.
Replace call-123 with the id from the previous response. tool_name is required for Gemini/Vertex.
Server-Sent Events; each data: line is a GaiseInstructStreamResponse (text, content, tool_call, usage).
Text embeddings. Usage is present only when the provider reports it.
GET /v1/models for OpenAI only; errors propagate as HTTP 500.
